name: Vacation days
source: A. Goossens, S. Vandevelde, J. Vanthienen and J. Vennekens, "GPT-3 for Decision Logic Modeling", RuleML+RR 2023 Companion, CEUR-WS Vol. 3485 (description 'Holidays', verbatim); originally DMCommunity challenge Jan 2016 (J. Vanthienen)
rules_text: Every employee receives at least 22 days. Additional days are provided according to the following criteria: Only employees younger than 18 or at least 60 years, or employees with at least 30 years of service will receive 5 extra days. Employees with at least 30 years of service and also employees of age 60 or more, receive 3 extra days, on top of possible additional days already given. If an employee has at least 15 but less than 30 years of service, 2 extra days are given. These 2 days are also provided for employees of age 45 or more. These 2 extra days can not be combined with the extra 5 days.
clarifications: Domain constraint years_of_service <= age - 16 added in the data dictionary.
